tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa ba gsum la gdung sems kyi gsol 'debs smon lam bzhugs so/ /

rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ /chos srung dam can drang srong bden tshig grub/ /gsol 'debs bu la brtse bas byin gyis rlobs/ /kye ma kyi hud nyam thag bdag lta bu/ /las dang nyon mongs bzod dkas yun ring mnar/ /'di la brtse chen thugs rje'i phyag rkyongs la/ /da lta nyid du drang bar mdzad du gsol/ /rang nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin mod kyang*/ /ma rig 'khrul pas srid pa'i 'dir 'khyams te/ /rmi lam lta bu'i 'khor bar nyam re thag /'di la skyabs dang skyob pa mdzad du gsol/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med brgal dka' ba/ /ye shes gru bo bla na med pa yis/ /sdug bsngal chu bo sgrol bar mdzad du gsol/ /yun ring dus nas goms pa'i bag chags gzugs/ /'khrul snang gzung 'dzin ri rgyal lhun mtho ba/ /rnam grol mchog gi ye shes rdo rje yis/ /da lta nyid du gzhig par mdzad du gsol/ /ma rig mun pa shin tu thibs po che/ /rgyun ring brtag dka' pha mtha' mi mngon cing*/ /'od gsal snying po'i sgrib pa rlabs chen 'di/ /ye shes zer gyis bsal bar mdzad du gsol/ /ji tsam 'bad kyang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgyu/ /snying po med pa'i 'jig rten bya ba las/ /bdag gi yid ni rab tu ldog nas kyang*/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar mdzad du gsol/ /tshul min yid byed chu rlabs gnyer 'dra ba/ /kun rtog sna tshogs yul lnga'i rjes su 'breng*/ /tshogs brgyad bag chags kun gzhir bcas pa kun/ /chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /rtog bcas bag chags 'dod pa'i sems nyon mongs/ /gsal ba gzugs dang mi rtog gzugs med kyi/ /srid pa'i sems gang bag chags rjes 'brel ba/ /de dag thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ /rang don sgom pa ltur len dman pa'i blo/ / gcig pu zhi ba gnyer las ldog nas kyang*/

/phyi nang gsang ba'i chos mchog lam zhugs te/ /rlabs chen gzhan don 'grub pa mdzad du gsol/ /lam gol log dang dman pa'i 'gro kun gyi/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags rab sbyangs te/ /sems nyid yid bzhin thar pa'i grong khyer du/ /ma lus phyam gcig bgrod par mdzad du gsol/ /sgrib pa'i rgya mtsho nyon mongs rnyog pa can/ /dus ring thog mtha' med nas nyer gnas pa/ /bdag cag mthu yis thar pa'i skabs med pas/ /brtse chen khyod kyis sgrol bar mdzad du gsol/ / shugs drag bzod par dka' ba'i nyon mongs ngang*/ /sdug bsngal mang ldan srid pa'i zug rngu dang*/ /bag med gzhan dbang le lo'i 'jigs pa las/ / de ring nyid nas nges par bskyab tu gsol/ /snying nas snying po med pa'i chos rnams la/ /mi rtag mi brtan sgyu ma'i blo brid du/ /nges par rtogs nas nges 'byung skyo shas kyis/ /nyin mtshan kun tu 'da' bar mdzad du gsol/ / 'phags pa'i ri ngogs dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ /rig dang mngon shes ting 'dzin 'grub gyur nas/ /don gnyis lhun grub bde chen mkha' spyod du/ / tshe 'di nyid la phyin par mdzad du gsol/ /gcig tu sran tshugs sgrub la brtson pa dang*/ /tshe 'di'i phyogs su skad cig mi g.yengs shing*/ /gong ma'i rjes snyogs dngos grub mthar phyin te/ rtag tu bla ma mnyes par mdzad du gsol/ /dam tshig nyams chag nyes pa med pa dang*/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras ma nor don rtogs te/ /nyin mtshan 'od gsal ngang las mi g.yo zhing*/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /snang srid rnam dag bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin te/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho sprin bzhin du/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis char bzhin 'bab pa dang*/ /phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod du gsol/ /dag snang mos gus phyogs med 'char ba dang*/ /byams dang snying rje rgyun chad med pa dang*/ /lta sgom yon tan nyams rtogs 'bar ba dang*/

/'gro don phyogs med 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi mos dge phun tshogs 'di yis ni/ /ma lus 'gro kun phyam gcig yongs grol nas/ /bde chen lhun grub kun tu bzang po'i zhing*/ /tshe 'di nyid la bgrod par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di'ang kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) rtsa ba gsum la gdung sems kyi gsol 'debs smon lam/ -PAGE 458--PAGE 459--PAGE 457-
